title: AWS access keys baked into container image or AMI
symptoms: Keys appear in docker history or AMI snapshots
Unexpected API calls from old environments
cause: Long-lived IAM user keys were embedded in build args, ENV layers, or baked machine images.
solution: Invalidate keys immediately; switch workloads to IAM roles (instance/task profiles); inject secrets at runtime via Secrets Manager/SSM; rebuild images without secrets.
workaround: Emergency key deactivation while redesigning role-based access.
